sources.snippet: SmolVLA is the XPolicyLab/RoboDojo adapter for the corresponding policy. It keeps integration-facing scripts at this directory level and leaves the original or vendored implementation in the nested source tree when present.

sources.title: SmolVLA Policy & Configuration | 22010303/bs | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: SmolVLA training is governed by YAML configuration files that define dataset locations, policy hyperparameters, and logging settings. The repository provides two primary configurations: smolvla_pih.yaml for peg-in-hole tasks and smolvla_omy.yaml for pick-and-place tasks.
